Doses such as this have been known to cause hospitalizations and/or deaths. Sometimes extremely high doses reported are errors rather than actual doses used.]
I was able to obtain a sample bottle of Auvelity, which is a new antidepressant containing Dextromethorphan (DXM), along with Wellbutrin
.
Took about 30 tablets.
Tripping balls about 45 minutes later, family notices and tries to stress me out.
What feels like involuntary self destruction mode I broke my bed frame being flung around my room and put a couple holes in my bedroom wall.  Apparently the ambulance came because my family was scared about an hour and a half into it and I don't remember anything until waking up in the ER.
They said I either had seizures, or serotonin syndrome, but I have used almost EVERY formulation of Dextromethorphan over the counter, including mucus and cold pills, and I have never had involuntary property destructive tendencies.
Overall, this stuff might be good for depression, but I highly recommend NOT trying to take it recreationally.
